title: Draft: DLT: Add support for integer type format (TYFM)
description:
The TYFM field specifies the formatting of strings, integers and floating point numbers.

This MR adds support for hexadecimal and octal unsigned integer formats.

See PRS_Dlt_00783 in
https://www.autosar.org/fileadmin/standards/R22-11/FO/AUTOSAR_PRS_LogAndTraceProtocol.pdf
